agents.activation.mediaHelp: Only for decision models that read pictures or video; others get the text alone. Each picture or clip makes the question slower. Asking only when a picture or clip is there skips the agent on other turns.
agents.activation.mediaWithinLabel: Ask only when a picture or clip is in
connections.builtinDictation.name: Built-in model (dictation)
connections.builtinDictation.removeBody: This deletes its files. Calls and Videos can't turn speech into text on this device until you download it again.
connections.builtinEmotion.about: Reads the feeling of each sentence in 35 languages, offline. {{license}} license.
connections.builtinEmotion.downloadBody: Downloads {{size}} from HuggingFace. While it reads it uses up to {{memory}} of memory, on the processor. License: {{license}}.
connections.builtinEmotion.failed: The emotion model did not download or load. Avatars use mood words for now; it tries again by itself in about 10 minutes.
connections.builtinEmotion.lowMemory: This device has less than 3 GB of memory, so avatars read moods from common mood words instead.
connections.builtinEmotion.name: Built-in model (emotions)
connections.builtinEmotion.noRuntime: This device can't run it, so avatars read moods from common mood words instead.
connections.builtinEmotion.note: It also downloads by itself the first time you open a Roleplay chat with 2D or 3D Avatars on.
connections.builtinEmotion.removeBody: This deletes its files. Avatars read moods from common mood words until it downloads again, which happens by itself the next time a Roleplay chat with 2D or 3D Avatars on opens.
connections.builtinEmotion.statusFailed: Could not read the emotion model's status.
connections.builtinEmotion.unloadsWhenId: It loads when an avatar chat needs it and unloads after 10 minutes unused.
connections.builtinTts.aboutKokoro: Fast and light. {{voices}} voices in American and British English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese and Mandarin Chinese. {{license}} license.
connections.builtinTts.aboutSupertonic: {{voices}} voices that each speak Korean, Japanese, English, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Polish, Portuguese and Russian. {{license}} license.
connections.builtinTts.didNotStart: The voice model did not load
connections.builtinTts.downloadBody: Downloads {{size}} from HuggingFace. While it speaks it uses up to {{memory}} of memory, on the processor. License: {{license}}.
connections.builtinTts.mixHint: Blend two to four voices into a new one. The sliders set how much of each you hear.
connections.builtinTts.mixSameVoice: Pick a different voice for each slider.
connections.builtinTts.name: Built-in model (TTS)
connections.builtinTts.nowVoice: Voice now speaks with the built-in voice model.
connections.builtinTts.readsInAutoHint: Korean, Japanese, Russian and Hindi text is recognised by its letters.
connections.builtinTts.removeBody: This deletes its files. Voice stops speaking with it until you download one again.
connections.builtinTts.removeBodyOther: This deletes its files. Voice switches to {{other}}, which is also downloaded.
connections.builtinTts.statusFailed: Could not read the voice model's status.
connections.builtinTts.supertonicTerms: Supertonic's license forbids using it to impersonate a real person without their consent, or to harass anyone.
connections.builtinTts.unloadsWhenIdle: It loads on the first line it speaks and unloads after 15 minutes unused.
connections.builtinTts.unsupported: The built-in voice model can't run on this device.
connections.builtinTts.voicesHint: Characters can each have their own voice in their Voice settings. Mixes you save show up there too.
connections.decisionDevice.memoryAny: About {{size}} of graphics card memory, or of RAM on the processor
connections.localModels.atOnceHint: How many requests the model works on together. Each one keeps its own copy of the context in memory. Auto picks 2 when there is room for both, otherwise 1.
connections.localModels.unloadedForIdle: Unloaded because it went unused. It loads again the next time something needs it.
connections.localModels.unloadedForMemor: Unloaded to make room for another built-in model. It loads again the next time something needs it.
connections.localModels.whenUnusedHint: Same for every built-in model. An unloaded model loads again the next time something needs it.
ui.chat.pictureCheck.help: The decision model looks at each new picture and checks it matches what was asked. Selfies are also compared with the avatar.
ui.chat.pictureCheck.label: Picture check
ui.chat.pictureCheck.linesHelp: One statement per line, up to 6. Start a line with not: for something the picture shouldn't show. Another picture costs another generation.
ui.chat.pictureCheck.linesPlaceholder:
Kaelen has short red hair
not: The picture has writing or a watermark
ui.chat.pictureCheck.mode.best_of_two: Always make two, keep the better
ui.chat.pictureCheck.mode.retry: Make another if it doesn't match
ui.chat.pictureCheck.reuseByLooking: Reuse a library background that looks like the place
ui.chat.pictureCheck.reuseByLookingHelp: When no background in your library is named for a new place, the decision model looks at up to 4 that share words with it and shows one that matches instead of painting a new one.
ui.chat.pictureCheck.skipShown: Skip a picture the newest one already shows
ui.chat.pictureCheck.skipShownHelp: Before drawing, the decision model compares the newest picture in the chat with what's about to be drawn. Pictures you ask for are always made.
ui.decision.visionRequired: Needs a decision model that reads pictures. Choose Liquid d1, Valen or Winnow in Library › Connections › Built-in model (decisions).
ui.lorebooks.decisionPictures.help: Only for decision models that read pictures; others get the text alone. Each picture makes the statement slower. Without a picture in the chosen messages, the statement reads as no and is not asked.
ui.lorebooks.decisionPictures.title: Show the decision model
ui.lorebooks.decisionPictures.withinLabe: Ask only when a picture is in
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.byoHelp: Paste a decision model's Hugging Face repository: an Open-Jev checkpoint, a GGUF that declares itself a decision model, or a Valen GGUF package. Add :Q8_0 after the name to pick one quantization. Marinara reads what the files say about themselves and only offers to install it if this build ships a runtime that can load it.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.confirmBody: This runs a second built-in model beside your normal one, with its own memory on the graphics card or, on the processor, in the computer's memory. You can turn it off again at any time.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.downloadPas: {{label}} downloads about {{size}} and uses about {{disk}} on disk once its runtime is installed. Declared licenses: {{licenses}}. Review them on the repository page before continuing.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.refusal.no_: Marinara could not tell which GGUF in that repository to install, or the quantization after the colon is not there. Add one that is, such as :Q4_K_M or :Q8_0.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.refusal.not: That GGUF does not declare itself a decision model this version of Marinara can run. Chat models cannot be installed here; add them as your built-in chat model instead.
That repository has neither a decision model manifest nor a GGUF file, so Marinara cannot tell what would run it.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.refusal.val: That Valen package was built for a different Valen runtime than the one this version of Marinara installs.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.reinstallBo: This installs {{label}} again. Files already downloaded and whole are checked and kept, so usually only its runtime downloads again.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.removeBody: This deletes the downloaded model and the runtime it runs on. You can install it again later.
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.speed.scene: a few turns of chat about {{seconds}} s
ui.modals.decisionmodelmodal.speedUnknow: Its speed on this computer shows here once it has run here.
ui.modals.stbulkimportmodal.skipAlreadyI: Characters and chats from an earlier import of this folder are left out, so running it again only adds what's new.
ui.modals.stbulkimportmodal.skippedAlrea: Skipped {{characters}} characters and {{chats}} chats you already had.
ui.panels.advancedsettings.expungeBackup: The backup failed, so nothing was deleted: {{error}}
Copies everything to the backups folder before deleting. Takes longer and needs free space about the size of your data.
Backup saved in the backups folder
ui.panels.advancedsettings.expungeFailed: Clearing stopped partway: {{error}}. Everything deleted so far stays deleted. Run it again to finish.
ui.panels.advancedsettings.expungeInterr: A clear didn't finish ({{scopes}}). Run it again to delete the rest.
ui.panels.advancedsettings.expungeKeepsR: This keeps going if you close Settings. Big libraries can take a few minutes.
ui.spriteGeneration.checkExpressions.hel: The decision model looks at each face after it is drawn and marks any that may not show its expression, so you can untick or redraw it. Takes a moment per face.
ui.spriteGeneration.checkExpressions.lab: Flag faces that don't match their expression
ui.spriteGeneration.checkExpressions.mis: The decision model thinks this face may not look {{expression}}
